verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs show pre-built 'payroll processing' Flows (gusto-docs-52) and platform capabilities to 'process regular and off-cycle payrolls' (gusto-docs-44), plus APIs to fetch upcoming/unprocessed payrolls (gusto-docs-40, gusto-docs-46) and a preview endpoint for contractor payments (gusto-docs-27), suggesting an end-to-end flow exists. However, there is no explicit documentation of a single regular-payroll flow that reviews hours/earnings and previews totals before submission (only contractor payment preview is detailed), so the core review→preview→submit loop for employee payroll is not fully evidenced. missing for 10: explicit hours/earnings review step for regular payroll, an explicit 'preview totals' endpoint/UI for regular (non-contractor) payroll, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the Flow performs review+preview+submit in one screen.
